brief.tc: 目前有兩個水務暫停，涉及中西區、九龍城區、元朗區、北區、南區和大埔區。火災危險警告仍然有效。十八間醫院的最長等候時間為四個半鐘，瑪嘉烈醫院的等候時間最長。海灘水質方面，有十二個海灘的水質為二級，二十八個海灘的水質為一級。
brief.en: There are currently two water supply suspensions affecting Central and Western District, Kowloon City District, Yuen Long District, North District, Southern District, and Tai Po District. A fire danger warning remains active. The longest waiting time at eighteen hospitals is four and a half hours, with Queen Mary Hospital having the longest wait. In terms of beach water quality, twelve beaches are rated level two and twenty-eight are rated level one.
